title: Spec-Driven Kanban Task Board
description: Machine-readable execution manifest for Phase 8-9 completion. Bounded slices, dry-run first, Postgres canonical.

tasks.title: Qdrant Point ID Bridge Materialization
tasks.description: Materialize deterministic qdrant_point_id mapping for all 54,650 points. Bridge from Qdrant scroll (verified with next_page_offset) to Postgres atlas_packets.qdrant_point_id column.
deliverables: atlas_packets.qdrant_point_id populated (100%)
Qdrant payload packet_key sync verified
Redis cache invalidation post-sync
acceptance_criteria: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT qdrant_point_id) FROM atlas_packets returns 54,650
No null qdrant_point_id values for canonical packets

tasks.title: Tree Node ID Propagation Through Envelopes
tasks.description: Propagate tree_node_id from atlas_packets to feature envelopes and recommendation cards. Ensures Neo4j topology identity chain is preserved end-to-end.
deliverables: atlas_feature_envelopes.tree_node_id populated
recommendation_cards.tree_node_id populated
Neo4j nodes updated with source_tree_node reference
acceptance_criteria: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM atlas_feature_envelopes WHERE tree_node_id IS NOT NULL = 58,365
No divergence between atlas_packets and envelopes on tree_node_id

tasks.title: Title ID Propagation Through Envelopes and Recommendation Cards
tasks.description: Propagate title_id from atlas_packets through feature envelopes, recommendation cards, and ACE context. Ensures consistent feature grouping across all downstream consumers.
deliverables: atlas_feature_envelopes.title_id populated
recommendation_cards.title_id populated
ACE context payloads carry title_id
Redis cache keys use title_id for feature grouping
acceptance_criteria: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM atlas_feature_envelopes WHERE title_id IS NOT NULL = 58,365
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT title_id) matches identity layer count

tasks.title: Arrow Batch Export/Import as Batch-Only Transport
tasks.description: Wire Arrow columnar serialization for batch packet transport. Enables zero-copy mmap, GPU tensor hand-off, and deterministic shape across processes. Batch-only: no streaming single packets.
deliverables: Arrow schema for CanonicalAcePacketEnvelope
Batch export: Postgres → Arrow IPC file
Batch import: Arrow IPC file → shared memory (mmap)
GPU tensor bridge accepts Arrow batch input
acceptance_criteria: 100 packets round-trip Postgres → Arrow → Postgres with zero divergence

tasks.title: Memory-Mapped Packet Registry Payloads (Parent Atlas 0-Latency)
tasks.description: Wire mmap-backed registry for Parent Atlas feature packets. Enables 0-latency L1 exact-match lookups and payload re-materialization without Redis round-trip.
deliverables: mmap registry file for 58,365 packet payloads
Feature registry offset index (binary search)
Lazy-load payload on query (0-latency after first page fault)
Parent Atlas uses mmap as L0 cache tier (before Redis L1)
acceptance_criteria: L0 mmap lookup latency < 1ms (after JIT warm-up)
Feature query: mmap payload hit rate > 95%
Registry file size optimized (JSONB sparse, no null padding)

tasks.title: ACP Routing for Keyword/Query/Error Fan-Out
tasks.description: Wire ACP (Agent Control Plane) routing logic for packet fan-out based on keyword match, query semantics, and error signals. Enables agentic error-fixing MapReduce clustering.
deliverables: ACP router: keyword fan-out (regex, trie, bloom filter)
ACP router: query semantic fan-out (Qdrant nearest neighbors)
ACP router: error signal fan-out (HMM classifier groups)
Agentic error fixing: error_signal_stream → packet_key mapping
acceptance_criteria: Keyword query routes to correct packet class in < 5ms
Error signal fan-out produces repeatable cluster assignments
No packet loss in any routing path (audit trail in Postgres)

tasks.title: Stub/Mock Cleanup in Live Lanes
tasks.description: Remove mock/stub implementations from live execution paths (Phase 8 Steps 2-7). Ensure all code paths use real Postgres/Qdrant/Redis, not in-memory mocks.
deliverables: All mock Redis clients replaced with real getRedis()
All stubbed Qdrant searches replaced with real collections
All mock Postgres inserts replaced with real transactions
Zero dangling @todo or @mock comments in critical paths
acceptance_criteria: grep -r '@mock\|@todo\|stubbed\|fake' sveltekit-frontend/src/lib/server/acp/ sveltekit-frontend/scripts/atlas/phase8* returns 0 hits in live paths
All getters use real service clients with error handling
Integration test: mock-free Phase 8 pipeline execution
